name: GS.daRun_NoAchievableRejection
lines: hinj : ∀ (j1 j2 i : Fin n), s.holding j1 = some i → s.holding j2 = some i → j1 = j2
⊢ NoAchievableRejection w m (daRun w m fuel s)
⊢ NoAchievableRejection w m (daRun w m 0 s)
(∀ (j1 j2 i : Fin n), s.holding j1 = some i → s.holding j2 = some i → j1 = j2) →
NoAchievableRejection w m s → NoAchievableRejection w m (daRun w m k s)
⊢ NoAchievableRejection w m (daRun w m (k + 1) s)

⊢ NoAchievableRejection w m (daRun w m k (daStep w m s))
